close_all: Flatten every layer immediately if account equity (free equity + collateral + unrealized) drops to 8,500, which is the royal-army floor (15% of the original 10,000; current equity is about 9,420 after last week's SOL stop-out, so this still leaves roughly 900 of cushion). Also flatten all if BTC prints a daily close below 74,500 (the weekly swing-low region and the lower-box tactic is dead) or a daily close above 84,000 (back above the old box, trend regime, range edges no longer have an edge). Otherwise no forced liquidation: at week end, if total realized+unrealized for the week is positive by more than +100 USD (4% of collateral), close all winners to bank the hostages and redesign RP next week; hostages (layers still underwater within the 25% RP stop) may be carried into next week under the same RP.
hostage_policy: Four armies, fixed RP each: 2,500 collateral, 10,000 notional (4x, within max leverage 10-40 of every watchlist symbol), 25% of collateral (~625 USD, about 6.25% price) as the only hard stop. Never add size to a losing layer, never martingale, never tighten a stop to free margin, never hedge the same symbol. A layer that goes against us is a hostage, not a loss: keep it, stop entering that symbol in the same direction, and hunt with the remaining armies, preferring the opposite side of a different symbol (BNB long is the current hostage, so lean on BTC/ETH shorts into resistance or SOL/XRP longs at box floors depending on which edge prints). Realized wins are used first to release a hostage when win + hostage loss >= 0 (path D from the article); if the hostage recovers to breakeven+fees while slots are needed, release it and re-enter only at a fresh zone. Max 2 hostages at once: with BNB already underwater, only one more layer may become a hostage; if 2 layers are underwater, stop all new entries and wait & see until one is released. After last week's SOL stop-out, re-entry into any symbol that hit its 25% RP stop requires a 4h reclaim plus BTC daily above 76,000. Profits above collateral stay in the main port as buffer; no Step 2 Big-Win bets until buffer exceeds 10% of collateral (+250), which is not the case this week.
rationale: Last week the box tactic worked on BNB (+151 short, then long re-entry now held as a small hostage) but SOL broke its floor and hit the 25% RP stop (-627), leaving the week about -490 net; equity ~9,420 is still above the 8,500 royal-army floor, so the game continues with the same four-army structure rather than changing RP after a loss. Market has shifted one box lower: BTC 78.0k (-7.3% 30d) is below both EMA20 and EMA50 (~80.4k), RSI 39, MACD negative but histogram contracting, with 10/30 low 76,264 and 10/29 high 81,955 defining the new range; alts are weaker (ETH RSI 35, SOL RSI 29, XRP RSI 37) and sit on fresh lows, so directional prediction remains low-edge while two-sided volatility (ATR 2.5% BTC, 3.7-4.6% alts) is enough to harvest small hostages at box edges. Following the Hostage Hunt design: Control Risk (4x total, 25%-of-collateral stop per layer, close-all at 8,500 equity or BTC daily close outside 74.5k-84k), Limit Resources (fixed 2,500 layers, one per symbol, max 2 hostages, BNB slot frozen), Wait & See (entries only at wicks into box edges with 4h confirmation, stricter re-entry on SOL, no mid-box trades). Notional stays 10,000 against RP collateral 2,500 since no reallocation happens; 4x is within every watchlist symbol's max leverage (BNB 10 is the lowest). Goal is Step 1 only: survive, release the BNB hostage, and rebuild the buffer by +1.5% to +4% per layer.
